display.purpose: Editorial hero and section headlines (Instrument Serif).

label.purpose: Tier badges and table headers only.

mono-num.purpose: The headline TAM value and all citable figures (tabular).

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Popovers, cards on hover, floating elements.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action and the Size gate. Solid indigo, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #5b5bd6); color: #fff; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 14px/1 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #6e6ee0; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #4848c4; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(91,91,214,0.35); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. White surface, ink text, hairline border, no resting shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #fff; color: #0a0a0b; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #d4d4d8; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 14px/1 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f4f4f5; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(91,91,214,0.35); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Market query and field input. Hairline border, global indigo focus ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input-search" type="text" placeholder="AI sales-ops agents, US, mid-market" />
components.css: .ds-input-search { background: #fff; color: #0a0a0b; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #d4d4d8; border-radius: 6px; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; width: 320px; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: #52525b; } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(91,91,214,0.35); }

components.name: Source-Tier Badge
components.description: Stamps a primitive with its provenance. Hue is contractual; always paired with the tier name.
components.css: .ds-tier-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(63,166,107,0.14); color: #2c7a4e; font: 500 11px/1.4 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tier-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #3fa66b; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill filter above the pyramid. Selected uses the accent tint.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 2px 8px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: #f4f4f5; color: #52525b; font: 500 12px/1.4 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: rgba(91,91,214,0.12); color: #4848c4; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(91,91,214,0.35); }

components.name: Canvas Card
components.description: Harvey-style workflow card for graph nodes and rail rows. Flat at rest, lifts on hover.
components.html:
US software developers
primitive · BLS OEWS
components.css: .ds-canvas-card { background: #fff; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.04), 0 0 0 1px rgba(15,23,42,0.04); transition: box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-canvas-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(15,23,42,0.08), 0 0 0 1px rgba(15,23,42,0.06); } .ds-card-title { font: 600 16px/1.35 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0a0a0b; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card-role { display: inline-flex; margin-top: 8px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #f1f2ef; color: #4b524b; font: 500 11px/1.4 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: TAM Headline
components.description: The signature figure. Geist Mono, tabular, counts up on load (instant under reduced motion).
components.css: .ds-tam { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-tam-num { font: 600 32px/1 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: -0.005em; color: #0a0a0b; font-feature-settings: 'tnum' 1, 'lnum' 1; } .ds-tam-label { font: 500 11px/1 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #7e7e86; }

narrative.overview: Strata is a market-sizing engine for VCs and operators who ask, of every number, 'where did that come from?' The interface answers that by design: every figure opens to its source, and competing methods sit side by side with their disagreement named. The visual system makes a number feel audited rather than asserted. It reads closer to a finance publication than a SaaS dashboard. The register is product carried by an editorial voice: Instrument Serif on headlines, Geist for the working UI, Geist Mono for every number. The tension to hold is editorial feel, operator speed.
keyCharacteristics: Light #FAFAFA paper, deep #0A0A0B ink, a single indigo accent used sparingly.
Editorial serif display + technical sans body + tabular mono numbers.
A load-bearing source-tier color system: every number wears its provenance.
Flat by default; shadow is a response to state, never decoration.
A separate 'night canvas' world for the signed-out marketing and auth surfaces.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Indigo is the only brand color and appears on <=10% of any app screen. Its rarity is what makes a selected node or a primary CTA read instantly.

rules.name: The Provenance-Color Rule
rules.body: The six tier hues mean exactly one thing each. A green chip is always a regulator source, never a 'success' decoration. Never encode meaning in tier color alone.

rules.name: The Numbers-Are-Mono Rule
rules.body: Every figure a user might cite is set in Geist Mono with tabular figures. Numbers in the proportional sans is a defect.

rules.name: The Serif-Is-Editorial Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif is for display and headlines only. A serif on a button, input, or data cell is forbidden.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow is a response to state (hover, float, focus), never a decoration applied to a static card.

dos: Do set every citable figure in Geist Mono with tabular figures (tnum).
Do keep indigo to <=10% of any screen; let neutrals carry the surface.
Do pair every source-tier color with its label, never rely on hue alone.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; add the Pop shadow only on hover/float/focus.
Do cap cards at 8px radius, 12px for large hero panels only.
Do verify the #7E7E86 metadata tier hits 4.5:1 on #FAFAFA before shipping body-sized text in it.
Do give every interactive element the global 3px indigo focus ring and a reduced-motion fallback.
Do reserve Instrument Serif for display and headlines.
donts: Don't ship the generic SaaS template: Inter-for-everything, purple-to-blue gradients, cards nested in cards, the rounded icon tile above every heading, or the hero-metric block.
Don't drift toward the legacy research report: opaque methodology, stock-photo gloss, or any number without a clickable source.
Don't ship academic/dry walls of text with no hierarchy.
Don't put numbers in the proportional sans, or a serif on a button, input, or data cell.
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right greater than 1px as an accent stripe.
Don't use gradient text or decorative glassmorphism inside the app (the night canvas is the one sanctioned glass surface).
Don't give resting cards a drop shadow, or round any card past 12px.
Don't add a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section.
